# 购买反向链接前，先做这 7 项站内修复

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2026-05-19 17:26（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/2056667751775645813
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

别买反向链接！

至少在你完成这 7 项真正能带来明显改善的站内修复之前，不要买：

1. H1 和 meta title 需要与目标关键词匹配，要清楚地体现它们针对的是同一个主题。

说真的，去检查一下你的主要页面。你的网站很可能只有一个面向读者的“营销”版本，却没有一个面向爬虫的 Google 版本。

2. 每个页面只讲一个主题。

是的，你的写手想在同一个页面里把那些其他东西都写上。但要在标准操作流程（SOP）中明确说明，这并不理想。如果他们想扩展，就应该新建一个页面，再从该页面添加链接。这就引出了下一点。

3. 添加内部链接。

大多数网站的内部链接都很薄弱。去博客里随便看一篇文章，你会发现整篇只有 3 个链接，而且全是指向营收页面的行动号召，却没有增强主题权威性。高度相关的内部链接还能加分。

4. 在前 100 个词内回答搜索意图。

这不仅有助于 SEO，也有助于获得 AI 提及与引用。（这两者不同：提及 = 品牌被提到；引用 = 链接到你的网站。）

5. 发布新文章之前，先更新旧文章。

大多数人很少这样做，但金矿就在这里。

6. 请 Claude 帮你做 Schema 标记：只需 10 分钟，就可能帮你获得丰富摘要、各种小摘要。

7. 删除孤立页面，或者给它们添加入站链接，因为 Google 真的很聪明。它只会遵循逻辑。

如果它笨一点，就会去找那些没有任何页面指向的页面，并在它们之间建立联系。但因为它做不到，这件事就得由你来做。

如果这些都检查过了，而且情况不错，那你就具备了良好的主题权威性，应该能获得不错的排名。

如果这些都做到了，却仍然没有足够的流量，那就该反复检查其他支柱：技术 SEO、内容生产质量、站外信号等。

需要帮助就联系我。我会回复所有私信。

## 英文原文

Don't buy backlinks! 

Not until you do these 7 on-page fixes that can rreeeeally move the needle:

1. H1 and meta title need to match the target keyword, it needs to be clear these are targeting the same topic.

But really, go check your main pages, your site most probably has a "marketing" version (for the reader) and doesn't have a Google version (for the crawlers) 

2. One topic per page.

Yes. Your writer wants to write about all these other stuff in the same page. But make it explicit in your SOP that's not the ideal case. If they want to expand, they should create a new page and link from it. Which takes me to the next point.

3. Add internal links. 

Most websites have weak internal linking. Go to your blog, check a post and you'll see 3 links in the whole text, all CTAs pointing to your money page but not reinforcing your topical authority. Brownie points for internal links that are closely related

4. Answer the intent in the first 100 words. 

That will help you not only with SEO but also on AI mentions and citations (these are different: mentions = brand mention; citation = links to your site).

5. Update old posts before publishing new ones.

Most people rarely do this, but this is where the gold is.

6. Ask Claude to help you with Schema markup: it takes 10 minutes and can help you land rich snippets snippities snipes.

7. Kill orphan pages or link to them, because Google is really intelligent. It only follows logic. 

If it was a bit dumb, it'll look for the pages no one points to and make a relation between them but because it can't, then that's on you.

If you check all these and things are looking good, then you have good topical authority and you should be getting some good rankings. 

If you have this and you're not getting enough traffic, then it is time to triple check your other pillars: technical seo, content production quality, outside signals, etc. 

Reach out if you need help. I answer all my DMs.
